replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
@Arachadonic - I am not on a build server... I am in creative, lol. I use McEdit to do all my mass changes, not worldedit... I don't have a server....

@ Jozzmcozz - I see no reason you are continuing to comment about me using a Hud / mod to build with. I have told you I do not break any Avicus rules. I do use mods to help me build offline. I do have the furniture mod and the more storage mod, and the camping mod, too many items mod, and about 20 more on this profile and that is no concern of anyone, but I will post screen shots with no mini map or coords mod next time. But thanks for expressing your concerns on a map making progress thread, really awesome... When you could have sent me something in game or to my email, or  Skype, or etc. if you had a concern. Instead we get people off-topic, and taking away from feed back about the purpose of the thread.
